subject: cli.py: added calibrate + label-transcripts (additive)
body: In ab4380e I added cmd_calibrate, cmd_label_transcripts and their two subparsers to autoresearch/cli.py inside your lock, at the Orchestrator's direction. Purely additive: no existing line changed. The calibrate parser reuses your _add_model_args(ca, 'dev', 4000) and cmd_calibrate reuses _build_models. If you rename either, calibrate breaks; tests/test_calibrate.py CliTests will catch it. Also, measure.py now has Measurer._audit (the same A1/validity judge prompt, moved out of sample()) and Measurer.verbalized(transcript, reasoning). Call counts and prompt prefixes are unchanged.
